definitions.explanation: A hand tool used to smooth and flatten wood surfaces by shaving thin layers. The traditional Japanese plane ({和|わ}かんな) is pulled toward the user, unlike Western planes which are pushed.

examples.japanese: かんな⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{滑|なめ}らか→滑らか：06068_nameraka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I smooth the board's surface with a plane.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かんな⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{削|けず}り→削る：03922_kezuru⟧⟦{屑|くず}→屑：03883_kuzu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: When the craftsman pulls the plane, thin shavings come off.

examples.japanese: かんな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Adjusting the plane blade is difficult.

notes:
KANJI WRITING:
- {鉋|かんな} (complex kanji, rarely used)
- Usually written in hiragana

JAPANESE vs WESTERN PLANES:
- ⟦{和|わ}→和：00418_wa⟧かんな (Japanese plane) - pulled toward user
- ⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧かんな (Western plane) - pushed away from user
- Japanese style produces finer, thinner shavings

TYPES:
- ⟦{平|ひら}→ひら：28886_hira⟧かんな (smoothing plane)
- ⟦{台直|だいなお}し→台直し：noentry⟧かんな (jointer plane)
- ⟦{面取|めんと}り→面取り：noentry⟧かんな (chamfer plane)
- ⟦{溝|みぞ}→溝：09410_mizo⟧かんな (groove plane)

RELATED WORDS:
- かんな⟦{屑|くず}→屑：03883_kuzu⟧/⟦{削|けず}り→削る：03922_kezuru⟧⟦{屑|くず}→屑：03883_kuzu⟧ (wood shavings)
- かんな⟦{台|だい}→台：13039_dai⟧ (plane body)
- かんな⟦{刃|ば}→刃：09865_ha⟧ (plane blade)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- かんな⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to plane)
- かんな⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to draw a plane)
- かんな⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧ (to shave with a plane)
- かんな⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧ (to sharpen a plane blade)
